decisions.title: Historic Central Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan
decisions.description: Guides reinvestment along Central Avenue between Laguna Drive and Sunset Road, pairing catalyst-site redevelopment with streetscape, pedestrian, bicycle, transit, wayfinding, facade-improvement, financing, and Route 66 identity strategies around El Vado and Old Town.
processing_notes: Original authoritative City PDF preserved without modification; 70 pages were text-extracted and visually reviewed.
Adopted December 2, 2013 under R-13-183 and Enactment R-2013-125.

decisions.title: Sycamore Metropolitan Redevelopment Plan
decisions.description: Preserves the Sycamore final-draft framework for mixed-use, hospital-campus, Central Avenue, Roosevelt-Parkside, transition-area, circulation, and redevelopment activities, including objectives for stronger pedestrian, transit, and bicycle connections and compatible infill.
processing_notes: Original authoritative City PDF preserved without modification; the 50-page scanned final draft was visually reviewed.
The retained scan is dated by its 1985 planning context; it is not presented as a current plan.

decisions.title: Soldiers & Sailors Park Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan
decisions.description: Preserves the 1985 draft for West Central between Tenth Street and Laguna Boulevard, addressing historic resources, mixed-use and housing redevelopment, parking, circulation, public improvements, financing tools, and the planned Fourteenth-and-Central gateway.
processing_notes: Original authoritative City PDF preserved without modification; the 16-page scanned draft was visually reviewed.
The cover is dated July 22, 1985 and marked draft.

decisions.title: City of Albuquerque Metropolitan Redevelopment Areas Map
decisions.description: Maps the City’s 2023 redevelopment-area portfolio, including the newer North Corridor, Menaul, Coronado, and Historic Central areas alongside downtown and legacy corridor, neighborhood, and institutional redevelopment geographies.
processing_notes: Original authoritative City PDF preserved without modification; the one-page map was rendered and visually reviewed.
Retained separately from the 2008 map because the portfolio and boundaries have materially changed.

decisions.title: City of Albuquerque Metropolitan Redevelopment Areas Map
decisions.description: Preserves the 2008 geographic baseline for designated redevelopment areas, showing the pre-North-Corridor and pre-Coronado portfolio, area boundaries, major streets, river, rail, freeways, and Central Avenue corridor relationships.
processing_notes: Original authoritative City PDF preserved without modification; the one-page map was rendered and visually reviewed.
Map footer dates this historical snapshot June 2, 2008; it is distinct from the 2023 portfolio map.

decisions.title: De Anza Motor Lodge Redevelopment Official Notice of Decision
decisions.description: Records the Albuquerque Development Commission’s selection of Anthea at Nob Hill to redevelop the De Anza Motor Lodge, with rehabilitation findings, preservation requirements, estimated basic-rehabilitation cost, landmark review, and the appeal deadline.
processing_notes: Original authoritative City PDF preserved without modification; all four pages were rendered and visually reviewed.
The April 28, 2015 notice is a specific redevelopment-selection record, not a duplicate of the Central/Highland/Upper Nob Hill area plan.
